name: Change of Plan

description.content: When the trial starts, you earn [2] Tokens.

While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use <Activate Ability> and spend [1] Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with [100%] charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.

quote: "Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god, oh my god." -Dustin Henderson
